title: Weighted and unweighted approximate tangent spaces coincide a.e. (Lemma B; Simon Ch. 3, Remark 1.8(1))
statement: Let N, k ∈ ℕ, H := μHE[k] on ℝ^N, let E ⊆ ℝ^N be H-null-measurable with H(E ∩ K) < ∞ for every compact K, and let θ : ℝ^N → ℝ satisfy θ > 0 on E and be H-integrable on E ∩ K for every compact K. Then for H-a.e. x ∈ E (H⌞E-a.e.) and every linear subspace Q ⊆ ℝ^N: Q is the approximate tangent space of E at x with respect to θ (HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt k E θ x Q, Simon Ch. 3, Def. 1.7: finrank Q = k and ∫_{η_{x,r}(E)} f(y)θ(x + ry) dH(y) → θ(x)∫_Q f dH as r → 0+ for every f ∈ C_c(ℝ^N)) if and only if Q is the unweighted approximate tangent space of E at x (HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt k E x Q, Def. 1.4).
lean_statement: ∀ (N k : ℕ) (E : Set (Eucl N)) (θ : Eucl N → ℝ), NullMeasurableSet E (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl N)) → (∀ K : Set (Eucl N), IsCompact K → (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl N)) (E ∩ K) < ∞) → (∀ x ∈ E, 0 < θ x) → (∀ K : Set (Eucl N), IsCompact K → IntegrableOn θ (E ∩ K) (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl N))) → ∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl N)).restrict E), ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Eucl N), HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt k E θ x Q ↔ Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt k E x Q
